meals.week: Every Sunday until Gaitz is at Support 3
meals.note: Coffee-Berry Paste: the only dish all three like.

gifts.gift: Common Coffee or Orgus Coffee; Training Weights; Arrowhead Gem

weekly.text: Book a Sunday Special Bath at the Thermae the week before each main battle: it lasts the chapter
detail: Bath pools and who gets which are in Rules › Thermae.

weekly.text: Keep boosting Combat Arts at [[place:Smyrnos's Temple]] for the Blacksmith unlock (Ch 11)

missables.text: Clear Anna's Paralogue by 10/4: free time ends before its window closes
detail: It also opens Anna's shop: north of Temple Row now and then, with rotating stock.

missables.text: Recruit Dante, Goliath and Jester before the Ch 11 battle, or they fight for Bertrand
missables.lose: any of the three still unrecruited
detail: Not at Renown 8 by 10/4? Push Anna's Paralogue (150 Renown) first, then recruit Dante in Ch 11's first days.
Goliath short of Giant's Meat: finish it before that battle too.

missables.text: See Fabio at 18:00 near Temple Rows: it sets up his Ch 12 scene, which upgrades Answerer
missables.lose: his Ch 12 scene and Answerer Arisen
detail: Appears only if you saw his Ch 5 scene in the eastern alleys.

note.text: Exam in the Ledger's Advanced order as each unit hits Lv 35 at 75% or better: 1 to 4 now
detail: Use the Megaira Licenses (Ch 8) or buy the rest in Dagsion now: 8 in all.
5 to 8 usually land in Ch 11 or 12. Giant's-Print Fort (Ch 12) drops a spare License.
Dante, Simon and Jester wait for Part II Ch 1 to 2 and its free Licenses.

buy.text: Buy the Advanced Licenses still missing in Dagsion
Trade at Vandahl for Archive Γ and read it on Olympia at once: Death Γ is her best nuke until Thoron
Look for a [[item:Giant's Ring]] in Anna's shop and in the Vandahl barter at [[place:Alecto]]

barter.for: Dante: Dark Spikes Τ for cavalry bosses

assign.why: Southern Passage (Ch 9): read it the day she joins

recruits.action: Pay 8,000G at Support 2 and Renown 8, before Ch 11
detail: Your second healer; she keeps Black Magic.
[[class:Bishop]] at Lv 35: Part II Ch 2 at the Army Training floor.
Deployed enough to reach Lv 35 in Part I, she can take Olympia's spot on the Advanced list.

recruits.action: Recruit at Renown 8: she's this army's only flier
detail: Not a [[class:Wing Soldier]]? Read the Flying Manuals until Flying D, then exam at 75% or better.
Part II wants 2 to 3 fliers; Dragoon isn't unlocked on this path, so Wing Soldier is the only one.
Her Leda copy is also a Wing Soldier, so the Part III merge adds less than two classes would.

recruits.action: Talk to her at Renown 6: she joins as a Lv 20+ Pugilist with Ursa's Right Claw
detail: Filler, bench only.

recruits.action: Hand over 2× [[item:Iron Bow]] at Renown 9: he brings a Levin Sword
detail: Filler, bench only.

recruits.action: Hand over 10 Dates at Support 3 and Renown 9: he supports Dietrich, Fabio and Jester
detail: Filler, bench only.

prep.text: Ursula from the backup window (10/1 to 10/10): she joins about Lv 25, so take Charioteer if needed
detail: Also the case if you were short of Renown 7 in Ch 9.

prep.text: Held Jester back? Recruit him before the Ch 11 battle: a Lv 25 Myrmidon with a Levin Sword
detail: Hand the [[item:Levin Sword]] to Dietrich for Anna's Giant and skip the Vandahl barter.
He still needs Bow B (Arena Infantry Training) for Ranger.

route.note: Renown 8, [[place:Aditi's Cave]]: skip if done in Ch 9
detail: Take him in Ch 9 instead if Renown 8 lands before 9/19.
Also clear any challenge you skipped: Borges, Aguirre, Sepente, Camilo, Cabaye.
Il-Lara too if skipped: it unlocks Guardian for later paths. All challenges end 11/27.

sub.note: Hand over the 2 spare Da Mina weapons from Ch 9: 20,000G and 100 Renown
[[place:Lake Brontes]]: same trip as the Yu Phas statue
[[place:Krove Ditch]], for the Noblewoman on Lower Temple Street
Follows For the Empire's Safety (Ch 8): 2 Wootz Steel
Follows A Letter of Some Gravity, which this plan skips

paralogue.note: By 10/4: Anna at Dagsion Summit, battle in Dagsion. Lose if Dietrich or Solel falls
detail: Bring 3: Dietrich (Levin Sword in the Concoction's slot), Yang Jie, Catania for the far ore piles, else Fabio.
Clear enemies, then the Abnormal Giant. Break the last ore deposit when ready: armor down, stunned a turn.
Keep Solel off the Giant until then; save Sol (2 uses). Avoid Vinicius. Vulneraries: the map has artillery.

explore.text: Opening scene: choose to ask Fabio about it, for a little Support
Talk to the Passionate Woman in front of the Arena: she gives a Concoction
About 20 Turns this chapter: Anna's Paralogue and the exams come first

tips.text: Split north and east toward the switches; mounted Io or Ursula reach them fastest
detail: The switches wake the center golems, which attack everyone: pull enemies south first.
Wasteland squares lower Avo: stay off them.

tips.text: Put high-Res units on Nezha's side: Catania, Fabio, Olympia
detail: Pack: Fabio and Esmeralda Pure Water, Goliath the Hexlock Shield.
Enemies include Dadao, Halvin, Nezha and Sha Lan.

tips.text: Anatolia summons 2 Lesser Titanus and a Greater Titanus as you reach her corner
detail: When her first HP bar breaks, finish her with Blaze Arts.
